title: Payroll environments: a non-production stack that behaves like production
name: Payroll environment settings

questions.prompt: A QA engineer ran a test payroll on the per-pull-request preview stack (APP_ENV=preview). It asked for a second approver, which never happens outside production, and once she entered one, two employees received real salary transfers and payslip emails. Staging and local runs are still fine. Fix environment.ts so the tests pass.
